answer: Before payouts, aggregate keys by settlement wallet and require a refundable bond proportional to their combined open claims; if a random audit proves copied work, slash the shared bond and reimburse the buyer. Splitting one operator across several keys therefore does not shrink the collateral or multiply rewards. A logistics bot could route walnut crates along a river to a haven. Proposed audit/bond administration: $0.04 per identity × 1,000 = $40, versus a proposed $0.04 one-time check for one honest agent. Limitation: attackers with separate settlement wallets can evade grouping.
